name: Peichurin
description: A kata that represents the one hundred and eight defilements in Buddhist philosophy.
history: Peichurin has Chinese origins and was adapted into the Goju-Ryu curriculum.
culturalSignificance: This kata is used to develop techniques and understanding in Goju-Ryu training.

detailedMeaning.title: Name and Meaning
detailedMeaning.content: Peichurin (百零八) means "One Hundred and Eight".
